description: A composite figure of five rendered images whose panels are of three different kinds, all serving one argument: that a cellular-automaton (CA) reconstructed volume reproduces the experimentally observed mixed-grain initial microstructure. (a) is an optical metallographic montage of three mutually perpendicular etched sections assembled into a cube, with X/Y/Z axes drawn at lower left and a 100 µm scale bar on each face; printed on the faces are d_ave = 166.00 µm (top), d_ave = 131.59 µm (right) and d_ave = 127.63 µm (left). (b) is the simulated microstructure: a multi-coloured 3D CA cube with equiaxed grains, labelled d_ave = 159.75 µm (top), 126.45 µm (right) and 133.83 µm (left), 100 µm scale bars, plus a schematic of the X direction with dashed slice lines projecting into a stack of coloured 2D sections. (c) contains three frequency-vs-grain-size histograms: "Metallograph" (cyan, AGS 141.66 µm, SD 54.54 µm, Min 10.22 µm, Max 265.20 µm), "CA" 2D (AGS 140.01 µm, SD 51.88 µm, Min 7.46 µm, Max 270.78 µm) and "CA" 3D (AGS 143.78 µm, SD 58.25 µm, Min 6.45 µm, Max 283.29 µm). Grain size (µm) spans 0-280 or 0-320; frequency reaches 0.4-0.5.

observations.observation: Panel (a) shows an optical metallographic cube of three orthogonal sections with a 100 µm scale bar on each face and d_ave values printed as 166.00 µm (top), 131.59 µm (right) and 127.63 µm (left).
Panel (b) shows a simulated CA 3D cube of coloured grains with d_ave printed as 159.75 µm (top), 126.45 µm (right) and 133.83 µm (left), and includes a slice schematic along the X direction.
The experimental 'Metallograph' histogram in (c) reports AGS in 2D = 141.66 µm, SD in 2D = 54.54 µm, Min in 2D = 10.22 µm, Max in 2D = 265.20 µm.
The simulated 'CA' 2D histogram reports AGS in 2D = 140.01 µm, SD in 2D = 51.88 µm, Min in 2D = 7.46 µm, Max in 2D = 270.78 µm.
The simulated 'CA' 3D histogram reports AGS in 3D = 143.78 µm, SD in 3D = 58.25 µm, Min in 3D = 6.45 µm, Max in 3D = 283.29 µm.

The experimental and simulated average grain sizes agree closely (141.66 µm experimental vs 140.01 µm CA-2D and 143.78 µm CA-3D), demonstrating that the created RVE reproduces the mixed-grain initial state.
The caption identifies the three panels as (a) optical results, (b) simulated microstructure and (c) experimental and simulated grain size distributions of the initial mixed-grain microstructure.
The citing text states the representative areas on different sections were all 550 µm × 550 µm, corresponding to the slices shown in panel (a).
The citing text states the experimental maximum grain size was 265.20 µm and the minimum was 10.22 µm, producing the mixed-grain distribution in Fig. 4c.
The citing text states the RVE used in the DRX simulation was 550 µm × 550 µm × 550 µm with a cell size L0 of 2.5 µm, as shown in Fig. 4b.

subfigures.description: Optical metallographic montage of three orthogonal etched sections forming a cube; grain boundaries clearly visible as a mixed-grain structure. Face labels d_ave = 166.00 µm (top), d_ave = 131.59 µm (right), d_ave = 127.63 µm (left); 100 µm scale bars on each face; X-Y-Z coordinate axes drawn below.

Simulated CA microstructure as a coloured-polygon 3D cube of equiaxed grains, labelled d_ave = 159.75 µm (top), 126.45 µm (right), 133.83 µm (left), with 100 µm scale bars. To the right, a schematic of the X direction with dashed lines showing how the volume is sliced into a stack of coloured 2D grain maps.
Cyan frequency histogram of experimental grain sizes (Grain size 0-280 µm vs Frequency 0-0.4) annotated AGS in 2D: 141.66 µm, SD in 2D: 54.54 µm, Min in 2D: 10.22 µm, Max in 2D: 265.20 µm.
Light-violet frequency histogram of simulated 2D grain sizes (0-280 µm vs 0-0.4), annotated AGS in 2D: 140.01 µm, SD in 2D: 51.88 µm, Min in 2D: 7.46 µm, Max in 2D: 270.78 µm.
Light-violet frequency histogram of simulated 3D grain sizes (0-320 µm vs 0-0.5), annotated AGS in 3D: 143.78 µm, SD in 3D: 58.25 µm, Min in 3D: 6.45 µm, Max in 3D: 283.29 µm.
